exposure: Patients with postpartum hemorrhage (PPH) during cesarean section
Patients with placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) disorder-related bleeding
cohort: 50 patients who underwent MY for PPH during cesarean section between January 1, 2009 and December 31, 2017
finding: The Matsubara-Yano uterine compression suture (MY) was effective in achieving hemostasis in 92% of cases of PPH during cesarean section, with a lower success rate observed in patients with placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) disorders.
mod_finding: The Matsubara-Yano uterine compression suture was found to be effective for achieving hemostasis in postpartum hemorrhage during cesarean section.
